title: 공항에서의 귀빈 예우에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (26) Omitted.
(27) Part of the Rules on Courtesies for Distinguished Guests at Airports shall be amended as follows:
In the portion other than the items of Article 4 (1) 4, "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade" shall be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs."
(28) through (126) Omitted.
